turns.assistant_text:
Dell Inc., formerly known as Dell Computer Corporation, is an American technology company that develops, sells, repairs, and supports personal computers (PCs), servers, data storage devices, network switches, software, and computer peripherals, including printers and webcams, among other products and services. Dell is based in Round Rock, Texas.

For more information, you can visit their [Wikipedia page](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dell).
